final: WITH g AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, AVG(CASE WHEN f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND f.rebrate IS NOT NULL THEN f.rebrate / f.feerate END) AS ar, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS c FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), m AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS mc FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.ar) AS avg_ratio, SUM(g.c) AS total_orders, AVG(g.c - m.mc) AS avg_excess FROM g, m WHERE g.c > m.mc
